violations.why: v_aspen++ in prism can be preempted by wharf's write, losing the update.
Higher-priority harbor can modify v_aspen between the read and write of the increment.
wharf can change v_aspen between prism's read and its later check.
harbor can change v_aspen between prism's read and its later check.
loom can change v_aspen between prism's read and its later check.
wharf can overwrite v_aspen between prism's increment and its check.
harbor can overwrite v_aspen between prism's increment and its check.
loom can overwrite v_aspen between prism's increment and its check.
wharf can overwrite v_aspen between flint's write and check.
harbor can modify v_aspen between flint's write and check.
loom can reset v_aspen between flint's write and check.
loom (higher priority) can reset v_aspen between wharf's write and check.
wharf preempts harbor's v_aspen++ and its write is lost.
loom preempts harbor's v_aspen++ and its write is lost.
